title: Transcription Verbatim Output
description: The verdict on each authored L1 file: every statement verbatim in the image narrative or transcription it names, every transcription word corroborated by the text layer unless listed under inspectionOnly, and unique keys.

report.description: One summary line per file and one FINDING line per failure. Exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 nothing to check (not a pass).
